description: Confirm the 6-digit code the owner received on WhatsApp from start_owner_phone_verification. On success the owner is verified: agents can message them, and platform numbers become connectable.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the WhatsApp message.

phone.description: The same phone number the code was sent to.

region.description: Optional ISO region hint, matching the one used when sending.

name: confirm_owner_phone_verification
title: Confirm Owner Phone Verification
